title: Design System: CoSeat 同席 — Team IM

display.purpose: Connection-card heading only; the wordmark shares the stack at 24px/20px.

title.purpose: Conversation title; 15px for pane titles and your seat name.

label.purpose: Author and room names, run titles, sources summary, permission rows; 13px/700 for the run state cell.

meta.purpose: Timestamps (tabular), thread names, previews, progress steps, notes and helper text.

caption.purpose: Synthetic label, count badges, source keys, gutter and rail times.

data.purpose: Placeholder fixture URLs only; never a costume for 'technical' text.

shadows.name: standing-card
shadows.purpose: A white card placed on the table: tiles, seats, research cards, sources, composer, suggestion chips.

shadows.name: card-on-felt
shadows.purpose: The selected conversation lying on the felt rail.

shadows.name: lifted-pane
shadows.purpose: Details pane while it overlays the chat below 1180px.

shadows.name: floating-pill
shadows.purpose: The 查看新消息 button floating over the stream.

shadows.name: connection-card
shadows.purpose: The connection card on the full felt screen.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for the pane slide (220ms), composer fold (280ms) and jump flash (1.8s).

motion.name: breathe-live
motion.purpose: Live marks only: running state mark, live dots, current progress step.

motion.name: hover-state
motion.purpose: Background and border colour on buttons, rows and chips.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transitions above are removed; states switch instantly.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Send and connect; felt fill with an optional authored icon.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20.5 12 4.2 4.3c-.5-.2-1 .3-.8.8L6 12l-2.6 6.9c-.2.5.3 1 .8.8z"/><path d="M6 12h6.5"/></svg>发送</button>

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions inside cards: 取消研究, 重试同一条消息.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:30px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid var(--n4,#c9d1cb);border-radius:var(--r-card,6px);background:#fff;color:var(--n8,#17201b);font:600 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI",system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s ease-out,background-color .15s ease-out}.ds-btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--n5,#858f89);background:var(--n1,#f5f7f5)}.ds-btn-outline:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2e8a67);outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-outline:disabled{color:var(--n6,#5f6b64);background:var(--n1,#f5f7f5);cursor:default}

components.name: Conversation Row
components.description: Rail rows on felt; the selected conversation is the white card on the table.

components.css: .ds-run{max-width:640px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--live-rule,#ead2a6);border-radius:6px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgb(23 32 27 / .04),0 3px 10px -5px rgb(23 32 27 / .3);font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--n8,#17201b)}.ds-run-top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 12px}.ds-run-state{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:112px;padding-right:12px;border-right:1px solid var(--n3,#dfe5e0);font-size:13px;font-weight:700}.ds-run-state svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--live,#b87310)}.ds-run-title{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;font-size:13px;color:var(--n7,#3f4a44)}.ds-run-title strong{color:var(--n8,#17201b)}.ds-run-cancel{margin-left:auto;min-height:30px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid var(--n4,#c9d1cb);border-radius:6px;background:#fff;font:600 12px/1.5 inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-run-cancel:hover{border-color:var(--n5,#858f89);background:var(--n1,#f5f7f5)}.ds-run-cancel:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2e8a67);outline-offset:2px}.ds-steps{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 0;margin:8px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;font-size:12px;color:var(--n6,#5f6b64)}.ds-steps li{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.ds-steps li+li::before{content:"";width:16px;height:1px;margin:0 8px 0 2px;background:var(--n4,#c9d1cb)}.ds-steps i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--n5,#858f89)}.ds-steps .done{color:var(--n7,#3f4a44)}.ds-steps .done i{border-color:var(--accent,#1d6a50);background:var(--accent,#1d6a50)}.ds-steps .current{color:var(--live-ink,#865410);font-weight:600}.ds-steps .current i{border-color:var(--live,#b87310);background:var(--live,#b87310)}.ds-steps time{font-weight:400;color:var(--n6,#5f6b64);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-run p{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--n7,#3f4a44)}

narrative.northStar: One table, named seats（同席之桌）
narrative.overview:
CoSeat keeps the skeleton every team-messenger user already knows: a conversation rail, one chronological stream, a composer at the bottom and an optional details pane on the right. The world on top of that skeleton is a meeting table. The rail is felt green, and the open conversation is the white card placed on it. Every member, human or agent, appears as a name-card tile with a word label for their kind. Your own name card sits on the composer and states your standing (出席 to speak, 列席 to read only) and when your speaking grant ends.

Work does not live in a dashboard. It arrives on the table as white cards that stand on a cool grey-green surface: a research card under its source message, with its state in a fixed first cell, and a result whose synthetic sources carry numbered keys. Message text itself is never boxed. Amber is reserved for things in flux, such as an agent researching, a cancellation awaiting its stop receipt, a lost connection or a grant about to expire. Dashed edges mark anything that is not fully real or not fully yours: synthetic results, demo notes, limitations and the read-only composer.

The density suits an Operate surface. Rail rows are compact, the in-app type ramp stays within 11–17px, and Windows system faces carry Chinese and Latin text. Motion only reports state: live marks breathe, the details pane slides in, the composer folds shut when speaking ends, and a result you jump to flashes. This record describes the built `web/` interface (index.html, style.css, app.js). Under PRODUCT.md these remain implementation decisions for this slice, not a ratified brand identity.
keyCharacteristics: Familiar IM structure; the metaphor lives in identity, permission and expiry details.
People and agents share one alignment; kind is a word plus a tile tint, never a different layout.
White standing cards on a grey-green table; a felt-green rail and connection screen.
State always in words beside a drawn mark; amber means in flux, green means done.
Honest synthetic material: dashed labels, plain-text placeholder URLs, visible limitations.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every neutral comes from the nine-step ramp `card-white` → `ink`. A new grey is a new token or a mistake.

rules.name: The Amber Means In-Flux Rule
rules.body: Amber marks work that is still moving or a deadline that is approaching. Completion is green, failure is red, and a confirmed stop is ink. Amber is never decoration.

rules.name: The State-in-Words Rule
rules.body: Every state pairs its mark or colour with words: 正在研究, 等待停止确认, 已停止, 已连接, 连接中断, 列席（只读）. Colour alone never carries a state at any width.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Inside the app, rank is carried by weight (400 / 600 / 700) on a tight 11–17px ramp. Only the connection card goes above 17px.

rules.name: The Standing Card Rule
rules.body: Identities and artifacts stand on the table as white cards with a hairline edge and the standing shadow. Speech never does: no bubbles, no boxed message text.

rules.name: The Dashed Edge Rule
rules.body: A dashed edge says "not the real thing, or not available to you". It marks the synthetic-result label, the 本地演示 tag, the demo-note rule, the limitations block and the read-only composer. Nothing else is dashed.

dos: Do keep the IM skeleton: rail, one chronological stream, bottom composer, details in the side pane.
Do keep people and agents in the same alignment, with kind as a word label (人类 / Agent) plus a tile tint.
Do put research state in the card's fixed first cell as mark + words, and derive progress only from server events.
Do show standing (出席 / 列席) and the speaking deadline on the viewer's seat card, and fold the composer when speaking lapses.
Do mark synthetic or unavailable material with dashed edges and words, and render fixture URLs as plain text.
Do keep every neutral on the `card-white` → `ink` ramp and every card on the 6px corner with the standing shadow.
donts: Don't use amber for completion, emphasis or decoration; it means in flux or time-bound.
Don't box or bubble message text, or move research into a dashboard away from its source message.
Don't show other members' grants, presence, typing or read state. The session API does not provide them, and the new-message count stays local to the page session.
Don't let colour alone carry a state at any width; the connection label stays visible on narrow windows.
Don't load remote fonts, icons or images, or use inline style attributes; the CSP forbids them.
